content.comment_body: Hello everyone! I used [product_name] with [article_no] to create a cargo elevator at [company_name]. I designed a ladder diagram, but encountered errors after downloading the program to the PLC, such as "M flags are too high" or similar messages. The simulation in [product_name] software worked without issues. I resolved the project by updating the ladder diagram to avoid using flags. I've attached photos—if anyone has suggestions, please share. Thanks! [user_name]
Hello [user_name]. Flags in your program function as intended. The issue is with the text message block SF004; the chain is left open. To fix this, press F4 followed by F2 in [product_name] software.

Hi [user_name] & [user_name]! [user_name] is correct: the message text block must be ended properly, with an open connector or a marker. The native format for [product_name] is Function Block Diagram (FBD), not Ladder—it’s available for convenience for those who prefer that style. In FBD, the message text block has a small output point that must be linked further or terminated properly. If you do this in FBD and then switch to Ladder, you’ll see the correct layout. Why is this required? Because function blocks in [product_name] software are defined with at least one input and a maximum of one output. For successful compilation and download to the hardware device, these rules must be followed. In simulation mode, the JAVA environment on your PC doesn’t enforce these definitions since it isn’t operating physical circuits. On the actual device, the block connections need to be handled accurately. Hope this helps you develop improved programming habits in the future! Have a great day!
Thank you all for the helpful advice and quick responses!

analysis.insight_summary: The user encountered inconsistencies between simulation and actual device functionality when working with ladder logic in [product_name] software. Simulated programs ran error-free, but issues appeared during download and execution on the hardware, notably with block termination requirements, highlighting differences between software simulation and real device implementation.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expected that programs running successfully in the software simulation would also download and operate error-free on the physical [product_name] device.
